name: The American Club
summary: Full-facility membership club in Claymore with dining, sport, and a large US-linked community — the default Orchard-fringe comparison point.
body: The American Club is a default comparison point for family memberships: pool, fitness, F&B, kids’ programming, and a dense events calendar in a Claymore / Orchard-fringe location. It suits households already living River Valley / Orchard / some Tanglin patterns who will use the club midweek, not only on showcase Saturdays. Waitlists and entrance fees are real — treat joining as a housing-adjacent decision, not an impulse add-on after a welcome tour. Ask HR about corporate seats before paying personally. Tour at your actual use times; compare against Tanglin Club (heritage/scarcity) and Hollandse Club (often stronger facilities-to-fee for Bukit Timah lives).
membershipNotes: Entrance fees + monthly dues + possible F&B minimums; ask about current waitlist by membership category and corporate transfer rules.
